name: Tempi — Mechanical Temp Service Desk
description: Front-desk agent for Mechanical Temp LLC, a licensed HVAC and mechanical contractor (Michigan license #7117025) serving Metro Detroit. Accepts service requests, maintenance-contract inquiries, and quote requests for commercial and residential HVAC, refrigeration, boilers, water heaters, and building automation. Requests are reviewed by a human before any appointment or price is committed.

skills.name: Request service
skills.description: Report an equipment problem and request a technician. Include facility name, full address, equipment type, symptoms, urgency, and an on-site contact with phone number. Mechanical Temp confirms timing and pricing directly; no appointment is final until confirmed.
examples: RTU-1 at a retail store in Southfield, MI is blowing warm air; store manager on site, medium priority.
Walk-in cooler at a restaurant in Redford, MI is at 48°F and rising; urgent.

skills.name: Request a maintenance contract
skills.description: Request a preventive-maintenance proposal. Include facility name and address, equipment inventory with counts (RTUs, splits, boilers, refrigeration, etc.), approximate square footage, desired visit frequency, and decision-maker contact.
examples: Need 2x/year PM on 12 RTUs and 4 split systems at a 60,000 sq ft office building in Troy, MI.

skills.name: Request a quote
skills.description: Request pricing for replacement, installation, or project work. Include site address, existing equipment details (make, model, tonnage or BTU if known), scope, and timeline.
examples: Quote to replace a 10-ton RTU on a single-story building in Livonia, MI within 30 days.
